'''Decipher (Reflections III foil)''' — [[Ric Olié (Reflections III Foil)|Ric Olié (foil)]] |sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists index] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) * [https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007) — Light Character: Ric Olie, Coruscant, R |strategy=By Doug Taylorhttps://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/ricolie.html So who's the best Light side pilot in the game? There have been some great ones, like [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]], [[Han Solo{{!}}Han]] and Wedge, but NEVER before have we seen one that adds a phenomenal FOUR to a ship's power. The only time we've seen this amazing level of skill was when [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] was piloting his Custom TIE. Until now. [[Ric Olié]] is much more than just an incredible pilot, however. He forfeits for 6 (8 when [[Security Control]] is in play). He's got solid power and ability of 3. And when he's piloting the [[Queen's Royal Starship]], he can use whatever Force you have available to wipe out enemy attrition. Now that's "getting out alive". Ric is an awesome pilot in any deck. With [[Squadron Assignments]] out, you'll want to get him aboard the Queen's transport as soon as you can to bolster any space contingent. Combos: Power 7, Forfeit 13, draws one battle destiny, immune to attrition < 4 and [[Lateral Damage]], and built-in attrition reduction, plus Hyperspeed of 7.
